제목 `WINTERLIGHT`, 설명 `내가 사랑하는 겨울`. `og-festival-night-v58.png`는 사용자가 제공한 1672×941 원본으로 crop·재도색·문구 삽입 없이 복사했다. SHA-256 `c120e4cc4605836e3dd880a535f58a29589fd59e99f679715d0dfb8bf06906dc`. OG/Twitter의 revision URL과 공개 canonical을 사용한다. 실제 외부 서비스의 캐시 갱신 시점은 보증하지 않는다.

# Silver / ice-blue identity

- Live wordmark: WINTERLIGHT. The name is confirmed by the user.
- Palette: cool white #f6f9fc, silver #c4d2df, ice blue #8bbde5, steel blue #5e87ab. No gold in brand assets.
- Static symbol: the exact loadingTreePath() curve, with original 600:540 proportions and uniform scaling. No added star or altered silhouette. Compact exports only adjust stroke weight for legibility.
- Share image: 1672×941, `/brand/og-festival-night-v58.png`. User-selected original PNG; no crop, text, or regeneration. Share title: WINTERLIGHT; description: 내가 사랑하는 겨울.
- A new filename and `festival-night-v58` revision avoid reusing the old image cache. Actual platform preview caches still require separate verification.
- Wordmarks use outlined bundled Pretendard 500, so SVG and PNG are identical without external fonts.
- Manual regeneration: node scripts/build-brand-assets.mjs. Committed assets are consumed by normal builds.
